paper.title: Simulations of state-of-the-art fermionic neural network wave functions with diffusion Monte Carlo
paper.authors: Max Wilson, Nicholas Gao, Filip Wudarski, Eleanor Rieffel, Norm M. Tubman

results.system_description: Be atom, all electrons, clamped point nucleus, 2 up and 2 down electrons
results.source_location: Table II (tab:atomic_results), 'Fermi Net* (This work)' VMC column
results.eligibility_evidence: VMC energy of the trained network from 1e4 batches of 8096 samples (Table caption); errors are standard errors of the mean (Sec. Results).
results.notes: N_up = 2, N_down = 2: not printed, but the 1S ground term of Be lies only in this sector (up to the mirror N_up <-> N_down). FermiNet* reimplements FermiNet, which assigns the spin polarization of the ground state of the isolated atom; the sector is not stated. The 'Fermi Net* + DMC' column is a projector energy and is not recorded.
